What You Need to Know Before Your Visit

	* Report Your Injury: Ensure you have reported the injury to your employer and filed a claim with WorkSafeBC to get a claim number.

	* Bring Claim Details: Provide your WCB claim number and date of injury to the clinic so they can set up direct billing.

	* Check Official Providers: You can cross-reference local clinics on the WorkSafeBC Metro Vancouver Physiotherapy Provider List.

If you'd like to narrow this down, let me know:
